about_the_game:
Synopsis

Step back into a world of tactical battles and dreamlike adventures in Eternal Dreamers Rising: a fast-paced, battle-focused RPG where every choice of class and strategy shapes your fate. Rebuilt with new systems, graphics, and soundtrack, Rising brings fresh life to the series with deeper combat than ever before and all-new heroes to master.

Features

⚔️ 14 Playable Classes — Mix and match to form over 1000 unique party combinations!

🧠 Strategic Combat — Master different quest types and outthink powerful enemies.

💎 Loot Without Limits — Hunt for rare weapons, armor, and special items across endless challenges.

🎲 Mini-Games & Diversions — Relax with dozens of fun, offbeat side activities between battles.

Story

A mysterious illness sweeps the world, trapping victims in an endless coma. Months later, researchers at the Advent Conglomerate make a startling discovery: all the victims share the same dream. Using experimental technology, they create a bridge into that dream world...

What they find is a realm between worlds, a crossroads connecting countless realities. Now, the race to end the Sudden Coma Phenomenon begins!

What's new in Rising?

• 3 New Classes — Shana, the wild gunslinger, Raze, the draconic brawler, and Corrin, the traveler!

• New Quest Type: SUPPRESSION — Face Death’s legions in brutal, large-scale encounters.

• New Quest Type: THE SINGULARITY — Face the most powerful bosses yet in raid-like encounters.

• Expanded Loot Pool — Hundreds of new items and equipment to collect.

• Full Rebalance — Reworked combat, AI, and progression systems.

• Visual & Audio Overhaul — New graphics, UI, and soundtrack for a richer experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Anything w/ OpenGL support
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

short_description: A mysterious illness traps humanity in an endless dream. Enter the dream, form your party, and fight to awaken the dreamers in this battle-focused tactical RPG.
